chapter.verse: Kei in Khazih bangin ka gamtat mah bangin note zong kei gamtat bangin na gamta un.
Note in na khempeuh sung pan kei nong ngaihsut uh a, ka hong piak bangin thu na zuih uh ciangin note ka hong phat hi.
Pasalte’ lu un Khazih ahi hi, numeite’ lu un pasal ahi hi, Khazih’ lu in Pasian ahi hi ci-in note in na theih nading uh ka deih hi.
Thungen ahi zongin, thuhilh ahi zongin a lu sin pasalte khempeuh in amau lu uh ahi, Khazih a daisak uh hi.

Ahih hangin thungen ahi zongin, thuhilh ahi zongin lu sin lo numei khempeuh in amau lu uh ahi, pasal a daisak uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua bangin ahih uh leh, sam met tawh kibang numei ahi uh hi.
Numei in a lu a tuam kei leh, a sam met ta hen. Sam at tanna, sam metna a zum huai ahih leh, a lu zong tuam hen.
Pasal in Pasian’ lim leh minthan’na ahih ciangin a lu sit ding a kilawm kei hi. Numei ahih leh, pasal’ minthan’na ahi hi.
Pasal in numei pan piang ahi kei hi, numei in pasal pan piang ahi hi.
Numei ading pasal piang ahi kei hi,numei in pasal ading piang ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vantungmite hangin numei in a lu tungah ukna lim a om nading a kilawm hi.
Ahih hangin Topa sungah pasal loin numei piang ahi kei hi, numei loin pasal piang ahi kei hi.
Numei in pasal pan a pian’ mah bangin pasal in zong numei pan piang ahi hi; nate a vekpi-in Pasian pan a piang uh hi.
Numei in a mai tuam loin Pasian kiangah thungen leh, a kilawm hiam kilawm lo hiam ci-in na khen ta un.
Pasal in sam sau a neih leh, zumhuaina ahi ci-in leitung ngeina thu nangawn in hong hilh hilo ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin numei a sam a sau leh, ama minthan’na ahi hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, numei’ sam in ama kituam nading ahi hi.
Ahih hangin mi khat peuhmah in hong nial leh, kote lakah ahi zongin, Pasian’ pawlpi lakah ahi zongin tua lo adang ngeina a om kei hi.
Ahih hangin note in hoih zawk nading hi loin, na siat zawk nadingun kikhawm na hih uh ciangin anuai-a thu kong piak mah bangin ka hong phat kei hi.
Amasa bel thu in pawlpi kikhopna-ah na kikhop uh ciangin khat leh khat na kikhen thangna thu uh ka za hi. Ka zak bangin kimkhat hi takpi dingin ka um hi.
Note lakah miphate a kilat nadingin pawlpi sungah kikhenna a om ding hi.
Note na kikhop uh ciangin na nek pen uh Topa’ Nitak-an ahi kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na neek uh ciangin kuamah kingak loin na manek tek uh a, khat gilkialin khat in kham lua-in na om uh hi.

Na nek nading na dawn nading uh inn nei lo na hi uh hiam? Ahih kei leh Pasian’ pawlpi kikhopna simmawh-in, a nei lote na zumsak uh hiam? Kei in bang ci ka hong gen ding hiam? Hih thu ah note kong phat ding hiam? Kong phat kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note kiangah ka hong piak thu in Topa kianga ka ngahsa hi. Ka ngahna in: Topa Zeisu a galte’ khut sungah a kipiak ding nitakin khomun la a,
hehpihna a phat khit ciangin khomun balnen a, “Hih khomun in note ading a kipia keima pumpi ahi hi. Kei nong ngaihsut nadingun hih bangin na bawl un,’ a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin nitak an a nek khit uh ciangin hai zong la a, “Hih hai in ka sisan in a kipsak thuciamna thak hai ahi hi. Hih hai na dawn uh ciangin kei nong ngaihsut nadingun na dawn un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in hih khomun ne-in, hih hai na dawn simun, Topa hong paikik matengin ama’ sihna thu a lak na hi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa’ khomun leh hai a kilawm loin a ne a dawn mi in Topa’ pumpi leh a sisan tungah a mawh ding hi.
Mi khat in a pumpi a kiteldot khit ciangin khomun ne in, hai dawn ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a ne a dawn mi in Topa’ pumpi a khen theih kei leh, ama tungah mawhna a tun’ nadingin a ne a dawn hi.
Tua thu hanginah note lakah thanem leh cidam lo mi tampi a om uh a, a si mi zong a om uh hi.
Eite in i pumpi i teldot leh, thukhenna i thuak kei ding hi.
Thukhenna i thuak ciangin leitungmite tawh mawhsakna i thuakkhawm loh nadingin Topa’ hilhna a thuak i hi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka ute ka naute aw, Topa’ an ne dingin na kikhop uh ciangin khat leh khat na kingak kim un.
Na kikhopna uh mawhna kikhopna a suah loh nadingin a gilkial mi in ama innah an ne hen. Thu a om laite ka hong tun’ ciangin i vaihawm ding hi.
